ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels relative to dominant low-intensity (black) background; white pixels are primarily localized in thin linear clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black field overlaid with a dense, multi-directional network of high-contrast white linear segments across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep vertex and symmetrical interior boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge exhibiting irregular micro-peaks and valleys; most prominent between the mid-lobe and the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory sweeping posteriorly towards tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular clusters of white/yellowish pixel blobs (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned, intersecting linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across the entire visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense accumulation of linear rake marks and parasitic/epibiotic colonization (barnacles) at the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex lattice pattern formed by intersecting white linear scars against the black base pigmentation.
